heroHeadline: Tbilisi Court Blocks Kulanin's Deportation to Russia as Thousands March 'Against Ivanishvili' on Protest Day 647
heroSubtitle: The Tbilisi City Court ruled that pardoned Russian activist Denis Kulanin can leave Georgia for a third country and rejected the Migration Department's bid to expel him to Russia, ending a standoff that began when he was blocked from a Sep 1 flight after his presidential pardon. Two days later, thousands marched from Avlabari to Parliament in the 38th Saturday rally under the banner 'Georgia against Ivanishvili,' joined by former president Salome Zourabichvili, on the protest movement's 647th consecutive day. Consecutive protest days now exceed 648.
